title: Pay with what you have
subtitle: One scan. KaleidoPay reads the receiver's rails from a BOLT12 offer and quotes every way your Bark wallet can pay them.
footer: KaleidoPay · Rate on iOS · mainnet quotes, nothing paid · bitcoin++ Berlin 2026
note: Mainnet quotes · nothing paid in this demo

steps.title: Scan the receiver's code
steps.body: One BOLT12 offer. Inside it, the receiver's rails in order: Bark, Lightning, on-chain.

steps.title: KaleidoPay quotes every route
steps.body: Bark, Lightning and swap providers on Nostr, all at once, every fee included.

steps.title: Their order, decoded
steps.body: Bark first, then Lightning, then on-chain. A plain BOLT12 wallet still sees a normal offer.

steps.title: Bark pays their Bark address
steps.body: Same Bark server, paid directly. No swap, no fee.

steps.title: Every way to pay
steps.body: Direct routes first, in the receiver's order. Their choice and the best price are marked.

steps.title: Or swap on the way
steps.body: Electrum swap providers found on Nostr turn your Lightning payment into on-chain bitcoin.

steps.title: Pick any route
steps.body: The total updates with its fee. Nothing moves until you confirm.
